name: crypto-observatory
title: Crypto Observatory: required returns, risks and survival
description: Crypto Observatory, by Agisilaos Papadogiannis: the required return of Bitcoin and four other cryptoassets computed each month with the MCM equation of the paper "Bitcoin's Required Return".
licence_note: The source data keep their own terms and CC BY 4.0 does not extend to them. Coin Metrics community data are CC BY-NC 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/), for non-commercial use with attribution: that covers the Bitcoin prices given here (price_usd, and the prices under state and path in data.json) and the figures that restate prices closely (volatility, beta, kappa, market share, drawdown, monthly returns). The equity market returns are copyright Kenneth R. French.
citation: Papadogiannis, A. (2026). Crypto Observatory: required returns, risks and survival, data to 2026-10-31. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24403325

paper.citation: Papadogiannis, A. (2026). Bitcoin's Required Return: Market Risk, Concentration and Mortality. Working paper.
paper.relation: The method. Every required return here is computed with the paper's MCM equation and constants.

sources.title: US equity market return, Kenneth R. French data library
US Treasury daily par yield curve rates (ten-year)
implied equity risk premium by month, Aswath Damodaran (NYU Stern): used for the sensitivity table only
ownership surveys and fund holdings as listed in config/model.toml

fields.name: month_end
fields.description: The month-end at which the required return is set

fields.name: required_lower
fields.description: Lower edge of the required-return band, percent a year: the average owner when fund and treasury investors are counted, with the low inputs

fields.name: required_midpoint
fields.description: Midpoint of the band, percent a year: the average of the two edges, a convention and not an estimate

fields.name: required_upper
fields.description: Upper edge of the band, percent a year: the larger of the two candidates below

fields.name: upper_if_surveyed_owner
fields.description: Upper-edge candidate, percent a year: the average surveyed owner with the high inputs

fields.name: upper_if_early_holder
fields.description: Upper-edge candidate, percent a year: the early holder

fields.name: upper_set_by
fields.description: Which candidate sets the upper edge that month

fields.name: risk_free
fields.description: Risk-free rate at the midpoint, percent a year: the ten-year Treasury yield

fields.name: market_term
fields.description: Market risk at the midpoint, percent a year: beta times the equity risk premium

fields.name: concentration_term
fields.description: Concentration risk at the midpoint, percent a year. At each edge it is risk aversion times variance times the holder's weight; at the midpoint it is what remains of the midpoint after the other three terms

fields.name: mortality_term
fields.description: Mortality risk at the midpoint, percent a year: a constant, the middle of the census range (0.3 to 3.5), the same in every month

fields.name: volatility
fields.description: Annualised volatility of Bitcoin used in the month, percent: the square root of twelve times an exponentially weighted average of squared monthly log returns, half-life nine months (computed from Coin Metrics prices)

fields.name: beta
fields.description: Beta of Bitcoin to the US equity market: covariance over variance of monthly log returns in the trailing 48 months (at least 12), kept between 0 and 3. Every estimate uses returns up to its own month only. The equity series is published one to two months late, so the latest months carry the last beta that could be computed

fields.name: correlation
fields.description: Correlation of Bitcoin with the US equity market over the same window as beta, carried forward in the same way

fields.name: weight_with_funds
fields.description: Share of wealth held in Bitcoin by the average owner when fund and treasury investors are counted, percent: market value over the wealth of surveyed owners (market value over their weight) plus the wealth of fund and treasury investors (their Bitcoin over 1.5%)

fields.name: weight_surveyed
fields.description: Share of wealth held in Bitcoin by the average surveyed owner, percent: the survey value, the same in every month

fields.name: weight_early_holder
fields.description: Share of wealth held in Bitcoin by the early holder, percent. When the early holder sets the upper edge, that edge is the risk-free rate plus this weight times variance, with no market or mortality term

fields.name: implied_equity_premium
fields.description: Equity risk premium implied by stock prices that month (Damodaran), percent; used only for the sensitivity figure

fields.name: midpoint_with_implied_equity_premium
fields.description: Midpoint of the band if the implied premium replaces the paper's fixed 4%, percent a year

fields.name: issuance_rate
fields.description: The month's new issuance at a yearly rate, as a share of supply, percent; context, not an input

fields.name: fund_and_treasury_share
fields.description: Share of supply held by funds and public companies, percent; context

fields.name: next_month_return
fields.description: Bitcoin's simple return in the calendar month after month_end, percent a month (from Coin Metrics prices); empty until that month is complete and the equity market return for it is published

fields.name: next_month_capm_unexplained
fields.description: That return, less the risk-free rate, less beta times the equity market's realised excess return in the same month; percent a month

fields.name: next_month_mcm_unexplained
fields.description: The CAPM figure less the month's required premium for concentration and mortality risk at the midpoint; percent a month. It equals return less required midpoint less beta times (equity market excess return less the 4% premium)

fields.name: trailing_3y_excess
fields.description: Average monthly return over the risk-free rate in the three years ending the following month, times twelve; percent a year, not compounded

fields.name: trailing_3y_capm_unexplained
fields.description: The part of it the CAPM leaves unexplained, percent a year

fields.name: trailing_3y_mcm_unexplained
fields.description: The part of it the MCM equation leaves unexplained, percent a year

fields.name: volatility_drag
fields.description: Half the variance, in points a year: what volatility takes from the average return of a position held alone and never rebalanced. The equation's holders keep part of their wealth in the asset and bear that part of it

fields.name: required_compound_lower
fields.description: What a position held alone and never rebalanced would compound at if the asset earned the lower edge of the band, percent a year: required_lower less volatility_drag. Not a requirement: the required return is an average

fields.name: required_compound_midpoint
fields.description: The same at the midpoint: required_midpoint less volatility_drag. It is also the rate at which the price itself would compound

fields.name: required_compound_upper
fields.description: The same at the upper edge: required_upper less volatility_drag

fields.name: pay_for_variance_lower
fields.description: Change in the lower edge for a unit change in variance: risk aversion times the holder's weight, a plain number. Above 0.5 the required return more than covers the drag of a position held alone and never rebalanced (half the variance); below 0.5 it does not. The holder herself bears only her weight's share of that drag

fields.name: pay_for_variance_midpoint
fields.description: The same at the midpoint: the average of the two edges

fields.name: pay_for_variance_upper
fields.description: The same at the upper edge: risk aversion times the surveyed owner's weight, or the early holder's weight where that holder sets the edge

fields.name: drawdown
fields.description: Percent by which the month-end close stands below the highest month-end close up to that date; zero at a new high. Context, not an input of the equation (computed from Coin Metrics prices)

fields.name: period
fields.description: Label of the period (years joined by an en dash)

fields.name: from
fields.description: First month-end at which a required return is set. The return compared with it is that of the following month

fields.name: to
fields.description: Last such month-end; the last return in the period is that of the month after it

fields.name: summary
fields.description: True for the two summary samples (whole sample, and since 2018), False for the three-year periods; the last period is shorter

fields.name: months
fields.description: Number of months

fields.name: delivered
fields.description: Average monthly return times twelve, percent a year. An arithmetic average, not a compound or buy-and-hold return: see delivered_compound

fields.name: delivered_compound
fields.description: Compound return over the same months, percent a year: what holding through the period earned. It differs from delivered in both directions: volatility lowers it, and compounding months within the year raises it when returns are large. Shown for reference; the tests compare averages, not this figure

fields.name: required_mid
fields.description: Average required return at the midpoint, percent a year. Each month's annual rate is converted to a one-month return, exp(rate/12) - 1, before averaging and multiplying by twelve, so it is on the same basis as delivered. It is therefore not the plain average of required_midpoint in months.csv and can lie below the middle of the two edges

fields.name: required_lower
fields.description: Average required return at the lower edge, percent a year, converted in the same way

fields.name: required_upper
fields.description: Average required return at the upper edge, percent a year, converted in the same way

fields.name: gap
fields.description: delivered less required_mid, points a year. This is not the unexplained return: see mcm_alpha

fields.name: gap_se
fields.description: Standard error of the gap, points a year

fields.name: excess
fields.description: Delivered return over the risk-free rate, percent a year

fields.name: market_part
fields.description: Part of the excess return that came with the equity market: beta times the market's own excess return, points a year

fields.name: concentration_mortality_part
fields.description: Premium required for concentration and mortality risk, points a year

fields.name: required_premium
fields.description: Premium over the risk-free rate that holders required: beta times the 4% equity premium, plus concentration_mortality_part; points a year. excess = required_premium + equity_beyond_premium + mcm_alpha

fields.name: equity_beyond_premium
fields.description: beta times (the equity market's realised excess return less the 4% premium), points a year

fields.name: mcm_alpha
fields.description: Return the MCM equation leaves unexplained: excess less market_part less concentration_mortality_part, points a year

fields.name: mcm_alpha_se
fields.description: Its standard error

fields.name: capm_alpha
fields.description: Return the CAPM leaves unexplained: excess less market_part, points a year

fields.name: explained_capm
fields.description: market_part as a share of excess, percent. A share of the average return, not an R squared. It uses the equity market's realised return

fields.name: explained_mcm
fields.description: market_part plus concentration_mortality_part as a share of excess, percent. Not an R squared; above 100 when Bitcoin delivered less than the two parts together

fields.name: average_beta
fields.description: Average beta over the period

fields.name: average_correlation
fields.description: Average correlation with the equity market over the period

fields.name: regression_capm_alpha
fields.description: Intercept of the regression under the CAPM, points a year

fields.name: regression_capm_se
fields.description: Its standard error

fields.name: regression_mcm_alpha
fields.description: Intercept of the regression under the MCM equation, points a year

fields.name: regression_mcm_se
fields.description: Its standard error

fields.name: month_end
fields.description: The month-end the required return is set at

fields.name: recorded_with_data_to
fields.description: Last day of source data in the build that first had this month-end as its latest month

fields.name: required_lower
fields.description: Lower edge of the band as first published, percent a year

fields.name: required_midpoint
fields.description: Midpoint as first published, percent a year

fields.name: required_upper
fields.description: Upper edge as first published, percent a year

fields.name: risk_free
fields.description: Risk-free rate at the midpoint as first published, percent a year

fields.name: market_term
fields.description: Market risk at the midpoint as first published, percent a year

fields.name: concentration_term
fields.description: Concentration risk at the midpoint as first published, percent a year

fields.name: mortality_term
fields.description: Mortality risk at the midpoint as first published, percent a year

fields.name: asset
fields.description: Ticker of the asset as in the Coin Metrics data, in lower case

fields.name: name
fields.description: Name of the asset in the Coin Metrics catalogue on 21 November 2026. A name can be newer than the event: the asset that collapsed in May 2022 as Terra (luna) is listed as Terra Classic

fields.name: entered_top_twenty
fields.description: Month it first entered the top twenty by trading volume

fields.name: died
fields.description: Date of death as classified in the paper's census. Death is a definition, not a delisting notice: the data feed ended more than 180 days before the end of the data, or the price fell below 1% of its peak and did not recover, or trading volume fell below 1% of its peak and below 250,000 dollars a day and did not recover. An asset that is dead by this definition can still be listed and trade

fields.name: kind
fields.description: Kind of death: abandoned or delisted, or sudden collapse

fields.name: rule
fields.description: The rule that classified it: trading dried up (three-month volume below 1% of its peak year and under 250,000 dollars a day), price below 1% of peak (and trading did not dry up), data feed ended, or sudden collapse (entered by hand at its public date). An asset dead by the price rule alone lost 99% of its peak value and still trades

fields.name: volume_at_end_usd_a_day
fields.description: Average daily trading volume in the source over the last three months of its data, in US dollars, rounded to thousands. It shows how much the asset still traded when the census was taken

fields.name: feed_last_day
fields.description: Last day the asset has data in the source. The census date itself, or a day or two before, for an asset whose feed was still running

fields.name: month_end
fields.description: Month-end at which the required return is set

fields.name: asset_id
fields.description: Coin Metrics code of the asset: btc, eth, bnb, sol, trx

fields.name: asset_name
fields.description: Name of the asset

fields.name: required_midpoint_pct_per_year
fields.description: Required return at the midpoint of the band, percent a year. The figure to quote, with the band

fields.name: required_lower_pct_per_year
fields.description: Lower edge of the band: risk aversion 1 and the average owner's weight counting fund and treasury investors, percent a year

fields.name: required_upper_pct_per_year
fields.description: Upper edge of the band: risk aversion 2.8 and the surveyed owner's weight (for Bitcoin before February 2019, the early holder), percent a year

fields.name: risk_free_pct_per_year
fields.description: Ten-year US Treasury yield at the month-end, percent a year

fields.name: market_term_pct_per_year
fields.description: Market risk at the midpoint: beta to US equities times the 4% equity premium, percent a year

fields.name: concentration_term_pct_per_year
fields.description: Concentration risk at the midpoint: what remains of the midpoint after the other three terms, percent a year

fields.name: mortality_term_pct_per_year
fields.description: Mortality risk at the midpoint, from the census of top-twenty cryptoasset deaths, percent a year

fields.name: volatility_pct_annualised
fields.description: Volatility of monthly log returns, recent months weighted more (half-life nine months), percent a year

fields.name: beta_to_us_equities
fields.description: Beta of the asset's monthly log returns to the US equity market over the trailing 48 months, kept between 0 and 3

fields.name: kappa
fields.description: Share of the owner's crypto holding that moves with this asset: covariance with the crypto market over the asset's variance, trailing 48 months. 1 for Bitcoin by construction

fields.name: holder_weight_lower_pct
fields.description: Holder's weight at the lower edge, percent of wealth: kappa times the average owner's crypto weight counting fund and treasury investors

fields.name: holder_weight_upper_pct
fields.description: Holder's weight at the upper edge, percent of wealth: kappa times the surveyed owner's 19%

fields.name: volatility_drag_pct_points
fields.description: Half the variance, in points a year: what volatility takes from the average return of a position held alone and never rebalanced

fields.name: required_compound_pct_per_year
fields.description: Required return at the midpoint less the volatility drag, percent a year: what a position held alone and never rebalanced would compound at if the asset earned its required return. Not a requirement: the required return is an average, asked by holders who keep part of their wealth in the asset

fields.name: sharpe_ratio
fields.description: Required return at the midpoint less the risk-free rate, divided by volatility

fields.name: sharpe_ratio_on_compound
fields.description: The same ratio on the compound required return. Descriptive: the Sharpe ratio is defined on average returns

fields.name: share_of_crypto_market_pct
fields.description: The asset's weight in the crypto market used for kappa (the five assets), percent, from the previous month-end's market values

fields.name: required_compound_lower_pct_per_year
fields.description: Lower edge of the band less the volatility drag, percent a year, on the same reading

fields.name: required_compound_upper_pct_per_year
fields.description: Upper edge of the band less the volatility drag, percent a year. With required_compound_lower_pct_per_year, the band of the compound figure
